title: claytonia mucronulata
intro: Claytonia mucronulata, commonly known as 'Alpine Spring Beauty' or 'Mucronate Spring Beauty', is a flowering plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Claytonia mucronulata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions like arthritis and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
